national_news.title: 80th Independence Day Celebrations to Highlight Yuva Shakti and 150 Years of Vande Mataram
bullets: The 80th Independence Day celebrations will be led by Prime Minister Narendra Modi from the historic Red Fort.
The Prime Minister will unfurl the National Flag and address the nation.
The celebrations will commemorate 150 years of the National Song, Vande Mataram.

national_news.title: Parliament passes Bankers’ Books Evidence Bill to recognise digital banking records as legal evidence
bullets: Parliament has passed the Bankers’ Books Evidence Bill, 2026, to modernise the legal framework for banking.
The Bill aims to provide a law relating to evidence with respect to bankers’ books and align it with digital banking practices.
The Bill makes electronic or digital records of a banker’s book admissible as legal evidence.

national_news.title: Lok Sabha passes Tribunals Reforms Bill, 2026
bullets: The Bill aims to improve efficiency, independence, transparency, and uniformity in the qualifications, appointment of service of Chairpersons and Members of Tribunals.
The Lok Sabha passed the Bill without discussion amidst opposition uproar.
The Bill seeks to reform the existing Tribunal system to make it more efficient and effective.

national_news.title: Union Minister Kiren Rijiju appeals to opposition to allow HM Amit Shah to make statement
bullets: Union Minister Kiren Rijiju assured that Home Minister Amit Shah is ready to respond to every point regarding student protests.
The Government is ready for a detailed discussion in Parliament regarding the recent student protests and related issues.
Kiren Rijiju urged the Opposition to maintain order on the floor and refrain from further obstructing proceedings.

national_news.title: India's Asiatic Lion Population Thrives, Expands Habitat and Range
bullets: India's Asiatic lion population has increased from 523 to 891 in the last 10 years.
The government's conservation efforts, backed by community participation, have been instrumental in protecting the species.
The lions' habitat and range have expanded, with a significant increase in their population.

national_news.title: Dr. Jitendra Singh calls for enhancing private sector participation in India's biotech ecosystem
bullets: Science and Technology Minister Dr Jitendra Singh called for enhancing private sector participation in India's biotechnology ecosystem.
The Minister stressed the need to build stronger linkages between India's indigenous biotechnology capabilities, industry, and investors.
The goal is to promote indigenous products and technologies in biotechnology and life sciences, and to move innovations from research to commercialization at a faster pace.

national_news.title: Indonesia battles wildfires across 107,000 hectares
bullets: Wildfires have burned over 107,000 hectares in Indonesia.
The largest fire is in Bromo Tengger Semeru National Park in East Java, scorching 743 hectares.
Authorities have closed the popular tourist destination until further notice.

national_news.title: Iran's FM Spokesperson: Strait of Hormuz to Remain Closed Until US Naval Blockade Continues
bullets: Iran's FM spokesperson Esmaeil Baqaei stated that the Strait of Hormuz will not reopen until the US naval blockade continues.
The Strait of Hormuz was closed due to US and Israeli military aggression against Iran, according to Baqaei.
The reopening of the waterway relies on conditions enforced by the US and Israeli authorities on Iran and the Strait of Hormuz.

national_news.title: Hockey World Cup to be played in new format; quarterfinal stage scrapped
bullets: The FIH Hockey Men’s and Women’s World Cup 2026 will feature a revamped competition structure.
The traditional quarterfinal stage has been scrapped, and the top two teams from each of the two crossover pools will advance directly to the semi-finals.
The tournament will be jointly hosted by Belgium and the Netherlands from August 15 to 30.

national_news.title: India wins two medals at World Athletics U20 Championships in US
bullets: Basant Kumar Meghwal won silver in men's high jump with a personal best clearance of 2.21 metres.
Shahnavaz Khan claimed bronze in men's long jump with a best effort of 7.84 metres.
This is the first time Indians have won medals in high jump and long jump at the championships.

national_news.title: Parliament passes Taxation and Other Laws Amendment Bill to enhance ease of doing business
bullets: The Bill seeks to amend the Payment and Settlement Systems Act, 2007, the Income-tax Act, 2025, and the Finance Act, 2026.
The bill will replace the Income-tax (Amendment) Ordinance, 2026, which was promulgated on 5th June this year.
The Ordinance was promulgated with the objective of mitigating the impact of external economic shocks.

national_news.title: TRAI Issues Direction on Use of 1601 Series Numbers for Transactional Calls
bullets: TRAI has issued a direction on the use of 1601 series numbers for transactional and service calls by entities in sectors other than BFSI and government.
The direction includes the implementation of 1601-series numbers for Utilities, Courier, and Logistics sectors entities.
The phase-wise implementation has been initiated by the Department of Communications for entities such as electricity distribution companies and LPG distribution entities.

national_news.title: First-ever export of mustard honey from Tripura to Dubai
bullets: The Agricultural and Processed Food Products Export Development Authority (APEDA) facilitated the export.
The shipment is the first-ever export of Mustard Honey from Tripura and is expected to open new avenues for diversification of Tripura's honey value chain.
The export marks a significant milestone for local beekeepers by creating an opportunity to access international markets.

national_news.title: Government Schemes for Indian Citizens
bullets: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment is responsible for these schemes.
Schemes aim to enhance social welfare, economic development, health, and education.
Eligibility and application processes are detailed for each scheme.

bihar_news.title: Bihar CM Transfers Rs 1100 to 1.13 Crore Social Security Pensioners on Bihar Pension Day
bullets: Bihar CM transfers Rs 1100 to 1.13 crore social security pensioners on Bihar Pension Day
The move aims to provide financial support to vulnerable sections of society
This initiative is a part of the state government's efforts to improve the welfare of its citizens
